title: RemoteCompose JSON Document
description: Comprehensive JSON Schema for RemoteCompose declarative & procedural documents.

export.description: Whether variable or color is exported to host

bitmaps.description: PNG images for texture3D. Only PNG is accepted, each dimension at most 65535; each image is written inline as TYPE_PNG_8888.

oneOf.description: Named entry: the source is value, or file, base64 or data next to the name

BitmapSource.description: A PNG image: a file path, or an object with file, base64 or data

oneOf.description: PNG file path; a relative path resolves against the parser's base directory

data.description: Alias of base64; may be a base64 data: URI

oneOf.description: Float constant, variable ref (@var), or RPN math expression (e.g. '@w / 2.0')
Expression over the grid coordinates u and v (e.g. '0.2 * sin(u * 6)')
Map of modifier names to parameter values

clearDepth3D.description: Clear the depth buffer. Needed before the first 3D draw of each frame.

fovY.description: Perspective vertical field of view in radians (default 0.9)

lights3D.description: Replaces the whole light set. No lights leaves the default ambient light only.

type.description: Default directional; any case. ambient takes neither dir nor pos.

dir.description: Required for directional: the direction the light travels, in world space

pos.description: Required for point: the light position

matrix3D.description: Post-multiply the model matrix, or save and restore it (push and pop)

op.description: Default identity; any case. Required when other keys are present.

indices.description: 3 per triangle, counter-clockwise for the front face

normals.description: Optional: x, y, z per vertex

meshPrimitive3D.description: A mesh the player generates. Each primitive takes its own named keys (see json-parser.md) unless params is given.

segments.description: Slice or side count, the subdivision level for icosphere; 0 = the primitive's default

uv.description: Texture coordinate mode (default none; any case)

axis.description: The axis the primitive's built-in axis turns onto (default native)

curvatureDensity.description: Place tube rings by curvature; tube, capTube and profileTube only

flags.description: Raw flag bits, OR-ed with the named options. The writer rejects bits 9-31.

params.description: Positional channel 0; replaces the named keys

twists.description: sweep: per-station twists in radians; requires scales

lineWidth.description: infinitePlane grid line width in pixels (default 1)

lineColor.description: infinitePlane grid line color (default #FF808080). Named and theme colors are not accepted.

oneOf.description: [a, r, g, b]: numbers in 0..1 or expressions

meshExpression3D.description: A mesh the player evaluates over a (u, v) grid

surface.description: Default general; case and _ are ignored

height.description: heightField: the height expression; cylinder: the height

normal.description: nx, ny, nz: replaces the generated normals

uv.description: u, v: replaces the generated texture coordinates

flipWinding.description: Reverse the triangles and the generated normals

flipNormals.description: Reverse every normal and keep the winding

flags.description: Raw flag bits: 1 = flip winding, 2 = flip normals. The writer rejects bits 2-31.

texture3D.description: Texture for later draws; only meshes with texture coordinates show it

bitmap.description: Absent, null or 0 clears the texture

mode.description: Engine and shading (default software-flat). An engine a player lacks falls back to software.

wireframe.description: Hidden-line edges in the paint color; forces the software engine

edges.description: With wireframe: the edges to draw: 0 (v0-v1), 1 (v1-v2), 2 (v2-v0)

transparent.description: Blend over the scene without writing depth

frontFace.description: Default ccw; any case. cw makes clockwise triangles front-facing.

touchExpression.description: A float that accumulates touch movement

expression.description: Maps the raw touch to the value (default touchX())

min.description: Absent: the value wraps around max instead of clamping

stopMode.description: A number, a numeric string, or gently, instantly, ends, notchesEven, notchesPercents, notchesAbsolute, absolutePos or notchesSingleEven (case and _ ignored). Default 0.

radialGradient.description: Single-circle form (centerX, centerY, radius) or two-circle focal form (startX/startY/startR plus endX/endY/endR, or focalX/focalY/focalR layered on centerX/centerY/radius). The two-circle form requires API 31 on the player.
